Build a single-key breakout board for a Cherry MX RGB in a Kailh hot-swap socket use the provided Cherry_MX part and a 6-pin 2.54 mm header.
Local dependencies: Use the project-local symbol library (Cherry_MX.kicad_sym) and footprint library (Cherry MX.pretty) in OUTPUT/lib; use standard KiCad libraries for everything else.
